description.en: Extensive library of responsive, beautifully crafted UI blocks for Tailwind.
description.zh: 包含数百个精心调校的响应式 Tailwind CSS UI 页面区块与组件系统。

content.en: TailGrids is an extensive UI block collection built on pure Tailwind CSS. Offering over 600 components, blocks, and templates across core marketing, ecommerce, and dashboard categories, it serves as a robust building kit for fast-moving web teams.
content.zh: TailGrids 是一套覆盖面极广的 Tailwind CSS 页面区块库。收录了超 600 个响应式组件与页面片段，涵盖品牌营销站、电商交易流与后台管理中枢等核心业务场景，提供 React、HTML 与 Vue 等多代码形态，开箱即拷。
